statement: Typing in the search box does nothing; the order list never filters as you type.
Searching by customer name matches nothing; the filter actually checks the item field.
The orders page always shows one fake "Test User" order, no matter what's really in the order data.
The last matching order for any search is always missing from the results.
The "Loading orders" message never goes away, even after the orders have finished loading and are visible on the page.
Searching for a customer with no orders shows a blank list with no "No orders match" message at all.
Clicking "Orders" from the admin home page leads to a 404 instead of the orders page.
Orders on the page are sorted by price, highest first, instead of their normal order.

category: works in dev but not on the production build
statement: The orders list works when developing locally but comes back completely empty once the app is built for production.
The two newest orders (Chidi Okafor's webcam and Dana Whitfield's headset) never appear anywhere in the app; it's serving an outdated snapshot of the order data.
The whole app fails to build: the orders page throws while rendering its initial (still-loading) state, and the production build never completes.
Each row shows the item name where the customer's name should be, and vice versa.
The search box is disabled as soon as orders finish loading; you can only type into it before the data has arrived.
Typing a lowercase name like "alice" finds nothing, because the search is now case-sensitive.
The orders page never loads any data; the API now only accepts POST requests, so the browser's normal GET request gets a 405 error.
The whole app fails to build; a broken tag in the root layout stops the production build from completing.
The production build fails because static export was turned on, but the app has a live API route (/api/orders) that static export can't support.
The admin home page fails to build/render at all because of a bad import; nothing loads.
The browser tab always shows "Untitled" instead of "Orders" as the page title.
The whole app fails to build; the admin home page references an undefined variable, and the production build never completes.
The orders page never loads any data at all; it's stuck on "Loading orders" forever.
The order list shows results in reverse order from normal.
Every order everywhere in the app shows "Sample Customer" as the buyer, regardless of who actually ordered it.
Every order on the page shows a blank instead of a price because the API renamed the price field from total to amount without updating the page.
`npm start` always binds to port 3999 no matter what port the deployment expects, so the live site is unreachable at its real address.
The orders page loads with an invisible pre-filled search filter, so it looks empty until you clear a search box that appears blank.
A search with a leading space never matches, even though the same text without the space would.

category: works in dev but not on the production build
statement: The production build now uses a different bundler than the one this app was written for, and it fails (or behaves differently) as a result.
The whole app fails to build: the admin home page's "Orders" link is missing its href, and Next.js can't prerender the page without one.
Right when the page opens, it briefly claims "No orders match" before any data has even loaded, instead of showing a loading message.
